semiconductor_relevance: High — Powatec GmbH specializes in high-quality assembly equipment and products specifically for the semiconductor and electronics industries.
summary: Powatec GmbH is a global provider of manual and semi-automatic assembly equipment for the semiconductor value chain, focusing on wafer singulation processes. Their product offerings include Wafer Mounters, Wafer Laminators, UV-LED Curing Systems, and a range of accessories for back-end processes.

regional_presence.Switzerland: Powatec is headquartered in Hünenberg, Switzerland, with representatives across the world.
